purpose: Collect a small, provenance-preserving public PRE sample before outcomes are available, without claiming population representativeness.

source_policy.primary: KEIRIN.JP official schedule and official PRE/racecard surfaces

sampling_frame.selection_rule: Within the preregistered 2026-08-21 through 2026-08-31 schedule window, choose one ordinary F2 event at each available 333m, 400m, and 500m bank category, using the earliest start date that satisfies the rule. 335m has no ordinary F2 target in this locked sample and remains unmeasured here.

events.official_schedule_title: Ｋドリームス杯サテライト姫路賞
前検コメはウィンチケット杯

sampling_frame.race_selection_within_event: On the first day only, after the official PRE/racecard is available, select the first three eligible races in ascending race-number order.
eligible_race: not special 9-rider or other exceptional format
sampling_frame.replacement_rule: If fewer than three eligible races exist in an event, use all eligible races from that event and do not replace them with later race numbers from a different event or a different date.

COMPETITION_SCORE.note: Past-performance-derived but visible before the target race; this Batch does not use it as an outcome or payout field.

PRE_LINE_FORECAST.semantic_guard: Treat as pre-race lineup forecast/prediction, not as verified executed line truth.
PRE_LINE_FORECAST.if_unavailable: Do not infer line membership from prefecture, style, score, commentary, or later results. Leave line-derived targets unmeasured.

planned_outputs: sample race inventory with retrieval timestamps and source locators
PRE line-forecast shape counts only if the official PRE line forecast is directly available
style-by-PRE-line-position counts only if that forecast is directly available
